_comment: Mirrors DEFAULT_SCHEDULE in index.html, for the push-reminder GitHub Action (scripts/send-push.js). It can't run the app's JS, so the schedule is duplicated here in a flat form. If you change times/meals/days in index.html, update this file to match or reminders will drift out of sync.

items.title: Wake up
items.body: No snooze. Feet on the floor, water, two minutes of stretching.

items.title: Breakfast: eggs
items.body: 4 whole eggs, toast or a paratha, a glass of whole milk.

items.title: Work
items.body: 9 to 5. The evening is already planned.

items.title: Lunch
items.body: A full plate: rice or roti, protein, vegetables.
